input.result:
Created `/home/user/myproject/nested.js` and ran it successfully.

The script performs a single nested `prisma.user.create` call that creates a `User` together with two `Post` records atomically, using `include: { posts: true }` to return the created posts.

Result written to `/home/user/myproject/nested_result.json`:
```json
{
  "id": 1,
  "email": "nested@example.com",
  "name": "Nested Writer",
  "posts": [
    { "id": 1, "title": "Nested Post A", "authorId": 1 },
    { "id": 2, "title": "Nested Post B", "authorId": 1 }
  ]
}
```

The `authorId` on both posts correctly references the new user's `id` (1), confirming the nested relation write worked in one round-trip.
